summary: Resolved capstone analytics reports dashboard data discrepancies across cohort volume, lifecycle statuses, and performance rates. Replaced static milestone card with dynamic Milestone Progression & Headcount Distribution chart. Added dynamic cohort aggregation by Academic Year and Section (BSIT 4A - 4D) with team-to-member allocation ratio charting. Implemented print-optimized layout architecture (@media print) with dark theme inversion (#ffffff background, #111827 text), break-inside avoid, physical print units (7.5cm), and institutional report header. Added automated audit warning banners and explicit sample denominators beside yield metrics.
preventionRuleAdded: Capstone Analytics & Reports Data Integrity, Dynamic Milestone Headcount, Section Cohort Aggregation, and Print-Optimized Layout Architecture Prevention Rule
